_comment: bowl PLAN-BOWL item 5 (docs/progress/bowl-release.md, 2026-10-18): optional sidecar read by tools/server/make_base_json.py next to tools/maps/bowl.json; emits base.json 'exits'. Host-verified 2026-10-18 on GPU-2 at the OLD positions (one gate beyond each pocket): the Army gate extracted a walked player (raid 1) and the BTR gate a teleported one (raid 7). 2026-11-12 (user request, ArenaMode session: the extracts are disabled in the team modes, so the green signal flare of ExfilSignals should mark the team's spawn area; rule R3): every map has one exit per team pocket and the box (4 x 3 x 4 m, rotation 0) stands INSIDE its pocket, centre inside the pocket's initial spawn-bound footprint of bowl.modes.json (rotated box, yaw 319), at least 2.5 m from every Player row to the box edge, on floor and without a solid in the box. Bowl BTR Gate: (49.3, 0.1, -11.1) in the east pocket (SPAWN_BOUND_FIGHTER north), centre 7.4 m inside the footprint (all four corners inside), 4.46 m of border clearance, 5.69 m to the nearest Player row, the box overlaps three unused trigger-layer marker boxes of other modes (TeamFight 'SPAWNS/Bear house' (17), (18), (19); non-solid, no marker centre inside), the closed BTR gate 6.7 m away. Bowl Army Gate: (-57.4, 0.2, -60.8) in the west pocket (south), centre 4.9 m inside the footprint (all four corners inside), 2.33 m of clearance, 3.86 m to the nearest Player row, the box overlaps three unused trigger-layer marker boxes of other modes (TeamFight 'SPAWNS/Bear house' (13), (14), (4); non-solid, no marker centre inside), the closed Army gate 4.5 m away. Names, sizes, times and types are unchanged (names are locale keys). Accepted consequences (R4): in a plain SPT raid a player now spawns a few metres from an 8 s exit (both pockets are parked open, held_gates is empty, so both exits are reachable); with the developer gate hold a held team can reach its own exit; bots never trigger exits (empty EntryPoint). OFFLINE, host-unchecked: confirm both boxes with uibridge_teleport dryRun=true and look at the flare from inside the pocket. EntryPoints is always the map's infiltration name; names double as locale keys. The pockets open at raid start through opened_barriers (DOORS_SPAWN_A, DOORS_SPAWN_B).
